kuhn.citation: Kuhn, H. W. (1950). A simplified two-person poker. In Kuhn, H. W. and Tucker, A. W. (eds.), Contributions to the Theory of Games, volume 1, pages 97–103. Princeton University Press.
kuhn.notes: Net chip value for the first player at equilibrium. Showdown pays the current stake to the higher card. A fold loses one chip. This constant is not derived from the Paignia trainer.
